{{Quote|Jasper, Mack Jasper. CorSec.|Mack Jasper|<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
'''Mack Jasper''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a proficient officer of the [[Corellian Security Force]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lt. Jasper? Ah yes, I remember him. Is he still with CorSec? I seem to remember he had quite a lot of skill with his hands. Woodcarving, I believe it was. Maybe stone sculpting. Something like that.|A gadget specialist|<ref name="SWG:SOtGS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Seek Out the Gadget Specialist|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mack Jasper was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the Corellian Security Force, stationed in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:WfC" /> He was a friend of the CorSec [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Hurley Klakk]].<ref name="SWG:DtMGitCCB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy the Mechanized Guardians in the Chirq Council Bunker|Corellia}}</ref>

Working for CorSec, Jasper once tried to arrest an undercover [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent, who carried the [[Codex of Tython]], an item of value for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. However, the Imperial was not ready to give the item up, and after a brief fight Jasper was disarmed and defeated. The agent was in a hurry, so he simply left Jasper sitting on the ground and went about his business.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

===The Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat===
{{Quote|I'm always looking for someone who can help me get things done. Someone who could go places I might have trouble going. Would that describe you?|Lieutenant Jasper, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WfC" />}}
Around the same time, Lieutenant Mack Jasper led an investigation to prove the innocence of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]].<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Receive the Thanks of a Grateful Diktat|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="card">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Mack Jasper}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jasper went to work with a spacer who was highly recommended by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:WfC" /> For a first mission, Lieutenant Jasper asked the spacer to investigate vandalism in the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]]. The spacer identified the [[Ragtags]] as responsible, hoping to blame the [[Meatlumps]] and get them into trouble.<ref name="SWG:CSV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Starport Vandalism|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:MackJasper.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lieutenant Mack Jasper conducting business in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].]]
Lieutenant Jasper once asked the spacer to investigate a missing shipment of starship components ordered by the company known as [[Ral Mundi]]'s [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium|Starship Emporium]].<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer discovered that the shipment was stolen by the Ragtag gang and retrieved it in the [[Coronet Capitol]]. More strikingly, the spacer also found a crate of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The spacer reported to Lieutenant Jasper, who decided to investigate.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer thus infiltrated the capitol and worked for [[Gallura Handerin]], a government aide,<ref name="SWG:WftG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Working for the Government|Corellia}}</ref> and [[Brantlee Spondoon]], the aide to the Diktat. During that time, an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] contacted Spondoon to discuss a plot against the Diktat. Even if the Rogue CorSec managed to assassinate the informant in a Coronet [[Warehouse (Coronet City)|warehouse]], Lieutenant Jasper and the spacer discovered the Rogue CorSec implication in that plot.<ref name="SWG:HGtII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Get the Informant's Information|Corellia}}</ref> From one of Jasper's informants named [[Jonset]], the spacer later learned that the Rogues were working with the Ragtags. The spacer thus attacked one of their secret meetings and finally discovered in a computer an order, apparently from the Diktat, instructing the Ragtags to smuggle spice into the Capitol.<ref name="SWG:FowtRCAD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find out what the Rogue CorSec Are Doing|Corellia}}</ref> Lieutenant Jasper immediately ordered a search of the Diktat's office, and the spacer found a remote relay device on the Diktat's personal data terminal.<ref name="SWG:StDO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Search the Diktat's Office|Corellia}}</ref> With this device, people were able to send files from a remote location and make them appear as originating from the terminal to which the device was attached. A gadget specialist easily identified the device, and Jasper therefore understood that someone had sliced the Diktat's terminal to plant the orders to smuggle spice. The gadget specialist also helped Lieutenant Jasper localize the origin of the transmission.<ref name="SWG:SOtGS" /> The spacer tracked the signal to the [[Rogue CorSec Base]] and infiltrated the base. The spacer downloaded proof of the Diktat's innocence and finally killed [[Hiram Bish]] and [[Mtara Vinram]], the Rogue CorSec commanders responsible for the plot.<ref name="SWG:GttSotRS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Go to the Source of the Remote Signal|Corellia}}</ref> The grateful Diktat awarded the Corellian [[Medal for Distinguished Service]] to the spacer for the service, and Lieutenant Jasper delivered the medal to the spacer.<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD" />

After those events, Lieutenant Jasper proposed to the spacer to work for other CorSec officers, Lieutenant [[Joth]]<ref name="SWG:ANA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|A New Assignment|Corellia}}</ref> and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]].<ref name="SWG:SwMW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Speak with Major Walden|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mack Jasper appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WfC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Mack Jasper was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:WfC" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:WfC" />
